rules.statement: A finding cannot be conclusive against a party if the decree was not based upon it, but was made in spite of it.
rules.supporting_quote: "Any issue decided by a Court in favour of the plaintiff whose suit is ultimately dismissed on another ground, cannot operate as res judicata as against the defendant in a subsequent suit. A finding cannot be conclusive against a party if the decree was not based upon it, but was made in spite of it"
